subject: Commercial terms: commit tiers, PO requirements, and vendor form
messages:
From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Marshall <lisa.marshall@finco.com>
Cc: procurement@finco.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal and commit tier options after demo

Hi Lisa / FinCo procurement team,

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning — great questions on latency and auditability. Attached is the commercial summary we discussed (redwood_proposal_0421.pdf). High level: we can support both pure usage billing (per-token) and structured commit tiers for customers who want predictable unit economics. Quick summary of the two options we recommend: 

- On-demand per-token: $0.0012 / 1k input tokens and $0.0036 / 1k output tokens; no minimums, billed monthly in arrears.
- Commit tiers (monthly): 500M tokens -> 5% discount to list; 1B tokens -> 12% discount; 3B+ tokens -> 22% discount. Commits are monthly commitments with a 3- or 6-month term option for price protection.

We can also offer a short 6-week pilot with a 10% introductory credit against usage if you want to validate latency profiles before committing.

Two ask items from procurement we expect: (1) do you require a preferred vendor form filled out? (2) will a PO referencing our quote and deal id (RW-2026-0421-FC) and net30 payment terms work for you? If you need us to sign FinCo's master agreement we can triage that, but teams commonly accept a PO + Redwood commercial exhibit to speed procurement.

I've attached the PDF and a simple commit_tiers_table.csv for internal math. Happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Connor Obrien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: redwood_proposal_0421.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: commit_tiers_table.csv (text/csv)
From: Lisa Marshall <lisa.marshall@finco.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@finco.com
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal and commit tier options after demo

Connor —

Appreciate the clear options. Procurement has a few mandatory items before we can route a PO:

1) FinCo requires vendors to complete our preferred vendor form and return it to procurement (I've attached the form).
2) We typically issue a PO that references our Master Services Addendum (MSA) terms — our standard requires net30 and specific indemnity/liability language. We cannot accept an open-ended per-token billing model without a commitment schedule or a capped spend profile.

If Redwood can commit to the tiers you proposed (and confirm you will accept a FinCo PO referencing a limited scope of the MSA for this engagement), we can fast-track this. I've also attached our redlined MSA for your legal review (FinCo_MSA_redlines.docx).

One more ask: does Redwood accept purchase orders that are issued monthly (i.e., incremental POs each month) or do you prefer a single PO for the full commit term?

Thanks,
Lisa Marshall
Head of Procurement, FinCo Payments
lisa.marshall@finco.com
Attachment: FinCo_preferred_vendor_form.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: FinCo_MSA_redlines.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Marshall <lisa.marshall@finco.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 11:12:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal and commit tier options after demo

Thanks Lisa — looping in Aditya (Sales Engineering) and Marissa (RevOps) to ensure procurement/finance are aligned. Quick responses inline: 

- Preferred vendor form: happy to complete. Please confirm the contact and I'll return the completed PDF by end of day tomorrow.
- PO approach: We can accept either (a) a single PO for the committed term or (b) monthly POs that reference the same deal id. For accounting clarity we prefer a single PO for the commit, but monthly POs are acceptable if they explicitly reference the deal id and commitment schedule.
- MSA redlines: we can't accept all standard enterprise redlines without legal review — primary blockers are broad indemnity and unlimited liability caps. Proposal: we can execute a short commercial exhibit that references your PO/MSA and limits the scope to the product usage in the exhibit; legal can then review the FinCo redlines in parallel. This is how we accelerated procurement for similar customers.

Attached: procurement_instructions.pdf (shows our preferred PO fields and sample invoice). Also attaching a CSV with the commit tiers converted to monthly spend targets (commit_tiers_table.csv). If you prefer, we can convert the tiers to a fixed monthly dollar commit instead of token counts for procurement paperwork.

Can you confirm who in FinCo Legal procurement will route the MSA to? If they need a contact at Redwood Legal, Marissa will coordinate.

Best,
Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: procurement_instructions.pdf, commit_tiers_table.csv
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Marshall <lisa.marshall@finco.com>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 16:30:07 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal and commit tier options after demo

Hi Lisa —

Following up from Connor. Quick operational notes from RevOps / Finance: 

- Invoicing: Redwood can invoice monthly in arrears and accept net30 payment terms. Please ensure the PO references deal id RW-2026-0421-FC and includes the billing address and tax ID fields in the vendor form.
- Vendor form: once completed we need the authorized sig and the W-9 / tax-equivalent for your region.
- MSA: We are open to executing a limited-scope exhibit that captures commercial terms and the commit schedule. Our legal team will review the FinCo redlines; that review typically takes 7-10 business days. If procurement requires signature first, we can do a conditional acceptance that is expressly limited to the 6-month pilot.

For speed, we can provision a production-safe sandbox and apply the 10% pilot credit Connor mentioned; once the vendor form and PO are in place we will enable billing for the live environment.

Please send the completed vendor form back to procurement@finco.com and cc marissa_cole@redwood.ai so Finance can confirm the tax fields.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: invoice_instructions.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Lisa Marshall <lisa.marshall@finco.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@finco.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal and commit tier options after demo

Connor / Marissa —

Thanks for the clarifications. Procurement is willing to proceed on the following conditional path: 

- FinCo will issue a single PO for an initial 6-month committed pilot with the token tiers you proposed (we will set the PO to the dollar equivalent instead of token counts to simplify accounting).
- Redwood must complete the attached preferred vendor form and accept the FinCo PO terms limited to this pilot scope (we will not ask you to sign the entire MSA now).
- Once vendor form is complete, I will route the PO (expect 3-5 business days).

Please confirm you will: (A) complete the vendor form and return to procurement@finco.com by EOD tomorrow, and (B) accept a PO with net30 referencing the limited pilot. If confirmed, I'll send DocuSign for the PO and vendor form.

Thanks — we are eager to move forward; the pilot needs to be in place before month end to align with our Q2 integration timeline.

Best,
Lisa Marshall
Head of Procurement, FinCo Payments

Attachment: FinCo_PO_template.pdf (application/pdf)
